basic_profile.bio: I'm a newcomer to the Reddit scene, diving deep into RPGs and modding. Born and raised in the Windy City, I spend my weekends exploring the outdoors and my weeknights delving into the world of tabletop games. Currently, I work as a junior software developer, which fuels my interest in game modding. I'm single and often online during the evenings after work, usually between 7 PM and midnight CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in software development, having studied computer science in college. My passion for RPGs started in high school, and I've been self-teaching ever since, diving into both the mechanics and the storytelling aspects. I'm particularly interested in how different games handle cultural and societal themes.
